title: Highway 2000
overview:
It's here - the Racer's wildest dream.

Race your top sports car against stiff competition, with loads of hot babes for co-drivers. Drive the fastest cars in the world accompanied by some of the most beautiful women on the planet. Enjoy the thrill of coming first, beating all competition to get the girl. Then feel your eyes bulge in their sockets as she shows you her appreciation.
